name: BELL Block (Basic Engineering Lab)
description: Basic Engineering Laboratory building housing foundational engineering labs, physics/chemistry facilities, and workshop bays.
notes: Houses First-year Physics, Chemistry, and Mechanical Workshop Labs. Emergency exit doors on east & west wings.

name: SRM Medical College Hospital & Research Centre
description: 24/7 Tertiary care hospital providing campus-wide emergency trauma, ambulance bay, and acute inpatient care.
notes: Trauma casualty entrance on ground floor. Dedicated ambulance bay with 3 standby ambulances.

name: SRM Main Security Post & Control Room
description: Central security control desk monitoring campus CCTV, emergency SOS beacons, and gate access.
notes: Central dispatcher for campus security patrol officers and rapid emergency response teams.

name: Main Arch Gate (GST Road Entrance)
description: Primary campus entrance connecting Kattankulathur campus to Grand Southern Trunk (GST) Road.
notes: Security barrier and vehicle inspection checkpoint. Direct pedestrian overpass to railway station.

name: Potheri Railway Station
description: Southern Railway suburban train station connecting campus directly to Chennai Central and Chengalpattu.
notes: Suburban EMU local train stop. Suburban foot overbridge directly links to SRM campus.

name: University Administrative Building
description: Headquarters for SRMIST Directorate, Registrar, Dean Offices, and Student Affairs.
notes: Student grievance cell, examination wing, and international relations office.

name: Central Library
description: 4-storey modern central library with digital research hubs, book repositories, and quiet study areas.
notes: Automated emergency sprinkler system and 4 marked emergency fire exit stairwells.

name: Tech Park (IT & CSE Block)
description: State-of-the-art computing laboratories, AI/ML center of excellence, and department offices.
notes: Card-access security doors after 6:00 PM. First-aid post on 3rd floor.

name: Campus Fire Safety Station
description: Dedicated on-campus fire fighting quick response unit equipped with fire tenders and safety gear.
notes: Trained firefighting crew on permanent standby for any campus thermal incident.

name: Emergency Assembly Point A (Sports Ground)
description: Primary open-air evacuation assembly ground for Tech Park, Library, and Engineering academic clusters.
notes: Equipped with emergency lighting mast and automated megaphone broadcast tower.

name: Emergency Assembly Point B (Central Quad)
description: Secondary evacuation gathering lawn situated directly south of the University Administrative Building.
notes: First-aid triage station will set up here in large-scale building evacuations.

name: Emergency Assembly Point C (Hospital Quad)
description: Dedicated muster station for Medical College and Hospital staff, patients, and students.
notes: Direct ambulance turnaround access lane.

name: Boys Hostels (Kaari & Paari Blocks)
description: Undergraduate residential blocks with 24/7 warden supervision, dining mess, and recreation rooms.
notes: Warden control desk at Ground floor foyer. 24/7 resident safety officers.

name: Girls Hostels (Senbagam & Meenakshi)
description: Secured student residential complex with biometrics access, warden support, and internal infirmary.
notes: Biometric turnstile access, internal CCTV surveillance and 24-hr female security guard desk.

name: Java Green Food Court
description: Multi-cuisine campus dining hub, bakery, juice bars, and student hangout area.
notes: High foot-traffic zone; equipped with wall-mounted public automated external defibrillator (AED).

name: SRM Dental College & Emergency Clinic
description: Dental hospital complex with outpatient departments and 24-hour maxillofacial emergency desk.
notes: Ground floor triage clinic and emergency oral surgery department.

name: Thangel Lake Safety Watch Post
description: Perimeter safety barrier and security post monitoring lakeside walking paths and water edge.
notes: Life buoys and emergency call box installed at 50-meter intervals along the promenade.

name: Valliammai Engineering College (VEC)
description: Autonomous engineering campus block with dedicated academic auditoriums and departments.
notes: Security post at eastern connector avenue.

name: College of Pharmacy
description: Pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacology laboratories, and clinical research wings.
notes: Chemical shower and first-aid kits on each wing.

name: Main Sports Ground (PG Play Ground)
description: Synthetic athletic tracks, cricket oval, football field, and stadium pavilion.
notes: Emergency assembly point for major campus sports events. Floodlit outdoor courts.

name: Dr. T.P. Ganesan Auditorium
description: One of Asia's largest university convention auditoriums seating over 4,000 attendees.
notes: Unverified coordinates in current plan - set via editor.

name: Bioengineering Block
description: Advanced genetics, biotechnology, and biomedical engineering research facilities.
notes: Specialized biohazard emergency wash stations on all levels.
